content.subject: Demand letter draft — please include the supporting authority
content.body:
Hello,

Following up on our call last Wednesday regarding the slip-and-fall at the shopping center. As we discussed, my treating physician's report came back and the lifetime-care estimate for the lumbar injury is substantially higher than what we initially expected. Given that change, I'd like to push forward on the demand letter to their carrier sooner rather than later.

Could the firm prepare a draft demand letter for my review by end of next week? Attorney Reyes mentioned that the demand should be supported by the controlling authority on premises liability for invitees, as well as the leading precedents on awarding future-care damages where the treatment plan is well-documented. Please include those citations directly in the body of the letter so that the adjuster can see we are serious and that the number is grounded in established law, not just an opening position.

My preference is to come in around the upper end of the range we talked about, and I think showing the authority alongside the medical evidence is what will move them. If there are additional cases on the duty owed by commercial property owners during inclement weather, those would be worth including too.

Happy to chat by phone if any of this needs clarifying before you start the draft.

Best regards,
Patricia
